title: fix(approvals)!: rejecting through the `approval_reject` action requires a reason
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D62xGLMbyWJaMEVnAMEjTK1)_
Fixes #35659
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published skills never teach the approval_reject action or its comment param, and nothing a metadata author writes changes

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:审批人通过「驳回」动作驳回时必须填写理由;不填或只填空格,动作接口、AI 助手和界面对话框(含收件箱与审批列表里的「驳回」按钮)都会拒绝提交,填了理由的驳回照旧生效;审批接口本身、SDK 方法与邮件里的驳回链接另有两张后续卡处理。
- 为什么做:落实维护者在记录页头部那张卡里的要求(驳回必须带理由),这次在服务端声明处强制,而不只是前端对话框。
- 出错会怎样:不带理由调用驳回的外部脚本或智能体会收到 400 校验错误,审批单保持待审;可直接撤回本改动恢复为可选。
- 要你做什么:无。

## Migration

Callers of `approval_reject` must send `params.comment` (a non-blank reason); there are no production customers and no stored data to migrate.

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts`: `approval_reject` declares its `comment` param `required: true` (was `required: false`), and its AI tool description says the reason is required. No new code path: the declared param contract (ADR-0104 D2, `validateActionParams`) already judges every action door before the target route runs, and already counts an empty or whitespace-only string as missing (`isActionParamValuePresent`).
- REST `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_reject` and MCP `run_action` refuse a missing or blank reason with the existing param-contract refusal: `400`, code `VALIDATION_ERROR`, message naming `comment`. The refusal is raised before the AI confirmation gate and before the approvals route, so the request stays pending and nothing is recorded. The console's param dialog already holds Confirm on a `required` param that is empty or whitespace-only (its translated `actionDialog.requiredError`).
- `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/reject` (the approvals route itself, `client.approvals.reject`) is unchanged and still accepts a reject with no reason, so the guarantee is scoped to the action: a reject through `approval_reject` always carries its reason. The route, SDK method and service `decide` leg is #35719.
- `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`: one sentence saying a reject through `approval_reject` carries its reason, and naming the three doors that refuse one without it.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`: two lines. The record-page Reject dialog step takes main's text (#35679's one header row), except its parenthetical: main said the declaration keeps the comment optional, so it now says `approval_reject`'s declaration requires the reason too, and a missing or blank one is also refused at the REST action door and over MCP. The declared-actions source line gives approve an optional comment and `approval_reject` a required comment, refused when missing or blank at the REST action door, MCP and the console. The item's revision history is untouched.
- `.changeset/35659-approval-reject-requires-reason.md`: `patch` with the BREAKING banner (non-protocol narrowing, AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3) and its ADR-0087 disposition.

Step 0, measured at origin/main 238661f4 (the branch base) and unchanged through 5d2ce34f for the files read: `comment` was `required: false`; `enforceActionParams` (packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts) is called once, in the shared action dispatch (packages/runtime/src/action-dispatch.ts) that serves both the REST door and the `ai` posture MCP `run_action` uses; `validateActionParams` treats `undefined`, `null`, `''` and whitespace-only strings as missing. The REST/MCP refusal sentence is English-only (the param contract's existing wording); no new sentence is added, so no translation is owed. No doc, skill or test text in this repo's own surface said the reject reason is optional beyond the AI description fixed here (see Acceptance notes for one checklist line outside the surface).

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.test.ts`: the spec validator over `approval_reject`'s declaration refuses `{}`, `''`, whitespace-only and `null` with one `required` issue on `comment`; CONTROL: a reason passes (with and without attachments); CONTROL: `approval_approve` keeps its comment optional.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` (the existing harness that boots the real security, flow, approvals and MCP plugins): the approver's reject with no reason, `''` or whitespace-only answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `comment` at the REST action door and over MCP `run_action`, and the request stays pending with no decision; CONTROL: a REST reject with a reason answers `200`, the request is `rejected`, and the decision row carries the comment.
- No existing test or fixture rejected without a reason (`approval-act-doors-read-visibility` already sends `{ comment: 'no' }`).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` after building the dogfood closure; expect 7/7 green, including the reject-reason pin.

Read first, by risk: (1) the `approval_reject` params hunk in `sys-approval-request.object.ts`; (2) the new `it` at the end of `approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`; (3) the changeset's BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 marker.

## Acceptance notes

- The inbox panel (`InboxApprovalItem.tsx`) and the approvals list draw Reject as the declared `approval_reject` through `DeclaredActionsBar`, so from this PR on they open the same param dialog and hold Confirm until a reason is typed.
- Remaining legs, outside this PR: #35719 covers the approvals route `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/reject`, `client.approvals.reject` and service `decide`, which still accept a reject with no reason. #35722 covers the reject reason on the email action link. This PR's guarantee is scoped to the `approval_reject` action: the REST action door, MCP `run_action` and the console dialog.
- The approvals platform checklist is kept true in this PR at the seat's request (5023ae8d, scoped in d1f69fb9, merged with main's #35679 text in f3505776). The approve path's optional Comment is unchanged.
- File surface: the claim names `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/**`, `content/docs/**` and `.changeset/*.md`; this PR also adds one `it` to `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`, because the order's tests list asks for the REST door and MCP path and that file is the existing harness reaching both, and edits two lines of `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` at the seat's request. Both are declared as surface extensions in the report and were accepted at L1.
- `approval_reject` remains `ai.requiresConfirmation: true`; over MCP the param refusal now answers before the confirmation gate, which is the existing ordering for every declared param.
